shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on every interactive element.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; font: 500 14px 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #fff; background: #3e63dd; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: #3358d4; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #3e63dd; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Native input with hairline border and accent focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; font: 400 14px 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1c2024; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #8b8d98; border-radius: 6px; outline: none; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #60646c; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #3e63dd; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(62 99 221 / 0.25); }

components.name: Sidebar link
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; font: 500 14px 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #3a5bc7; background: #edf2fe; border-radius: 6px; text-decoration: none; }

narrative.overview: A conventional neutral kit at Radix/Linear craft: slate grays, one blue accent, Inter, flat hairline surfaces, every state designed.
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces, modal is the only shadow

rules.name: One Accent
rules.body: Blue is the only accent; red and green carry meaning.

rules.name: Soft for Secondary
rules.body: Secondary emphasis is a soft accent tint with accent text.

rules.name: Flat by Default
rules.body: Only the modal casts a real shadow.
